# Haiyun Wang Real Estate — haiyunwang.ca

Haiyun Wang (王海云) is a Chinese-English bilingual REALTOR® and team leader in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada.
Phone: +1-613-710-9966. Brokerage: Royal LePage Integrity Realty. Team: Upside Realty (旺家地产).

Service areas: Ottawa, Kanata, Stittsville, Barrhaven, Nepean, Riverside South, Orléans.
Services: buying, selling, leasing (tenant and landlord side), commercial real estate.

Notable awards (client-confirmed; documentary evidence pending):

- 2025 Quadruple Platinum Award
- #1 Individual Units Sold, Ottawa (Keller Williams, November 2024); #2 in Canada
